title: MA-SQLGrid: A Controlled Factorial Study of Context Grounding for Text-to-SQL over a Power-Grid Maintenance Database

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The BIRD description used development-stage wording and did not state the complete frozen call design at first presentation.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The Methods now states 500 items, 11 databases, four independent methods, 2500 calls per backbone, 5000 calls total, 4000 final outputs, FROZEN_NOT_RUN status, absent human approval, zero calls/outputs, required post-run re-execution, and the non-sealed/non-DKASQL boundary.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The distinction between the 91 development-visible candidates, later human review, and genuine sealing needed to be explicit.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The 91 records are now described as blank-review-form development data that may become human-reviewed but cannot become sealed retroactively.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The future sealed-set language lacked operational conditions.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The manuscript now requires new or deeply rewritten items after method freeze, overlap screening, access custody, independent review/adjudication, and one registered no-drop execution; it states that no such set currently exists.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Agent-role and internal workflow wording could be mistaken for qualified human review or read as process metadata.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The order screen is described as two independent prediction-blinded machine-assisted protocol audits, with an explicit statement that it is not qualified human semantic review. Agent-role labels were removed from the manuscript.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Internal decision jargon such as promotion and NO--GO reduced readability.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: These terms were replaced by registered analysis, declared evidence rule, or declared decision rule without changing any numerical conclusion.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Several sentences used stronger or promotional verbs than the finite evidence supports.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Demonstrates/strengthens/sharpens and priority-of-invention language were replaced by evaluates/is consistent with/indicates/refines and explicit bounded-claim language.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Internal W10_FRONT_MATTER markers appeared in rendered declarations and supplementary information.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: They were replaced by natural, explicit pending-author or pending-license statements. No missing contribution, funding, conflict, ethics, consent, AI-use, license, or DOI value was fabricated.

issues_and_resolutions.issue: The revised abstract initially exceeded the approximately 200-word journal target.
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: The final mechanical word-like count is 194 while retaining design, primary results, review boundary, and limitations.

evidence_boundaries.bird: FROZEN_NOT_RUN; human approval absent; zero model calls; zero outputs; no score in the manuscript
evidence_boundaries.external_91: development-visible automatic candidates; zero completed qualified reviews; unsealed
evidence_boundaries.future_sealed: does not yet exist; must satisfy new-content, method-freeze, overlap, custody, review/adjudication and no-drop execution gates
evidence_boundaries.machine_assisted_order_screen: protocol screen only; not human annotation or semantic certification
evidence_boundaries.pending_declarations: visible in natural academic language and still require authors or legal/repository action
